name: manual_155a3f
claim: After any git commit whose 'files changed' count looks smaller than what was staged, verify with git show --stat HEAD before trusting the commit captured everything -- a successful exit code does not guarantee every staged file actually landed if something touched the working tree or index between add and commit.

decisions.notes: In orama-system's own (non-shared) checkout, git add staged 10 files but the resulting commit showed only 4 files changed, with no error surfaced. Caught only because git show --stat HEAD was checked immediately after instead of assuming success from exit code 0; the remaining 6 files were still present as uncommitted changes and were re-staged and committed separately. Root cause not fully diagnosed (possibly the pre-commit hook's own repo-hygiene invocation touching state, or brief concurrent activity), but the fix -- always verify post-commit, not just pre-commit -- holds regardless of cause.
